worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.summary: Call a strange pillar of light down over a target (or a chosen point): it tracks the target while falling, then freezes its anchor for a short lock so the foe can dodge the last moment. The strike deals special damage and savagely cuts 2 stages of Sp. Def; anyone caught in the ring at the final anchor takes splash damage, and the struck target keeps a lingering light afterimage. A target that leaves the tracking range before the lock is not chased and the pillar may fall on empty ground. Disperse form hits a group more lightly; focus form is one thin pillar with a heavier single hit.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.0: Savage a single target for 2 stages of Sp. Def and open it up for special attackers
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.1: Call light down on one named target from range
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.use.2: Use disperse form to smash the target and those around it
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.descriptio: The pillar strikes the target for about %1$s special damage and lowers its Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The pillar falls over %1$s, freezing its anchor for the last %2$s; a target that gets %3$s blocks from the caster is no longer tracked and the pillar may fall on empty ground.
Other foes within %1$s blocks of the final anchor take about %2$s special damage (splash only, no Sp. Def drop).
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.disperse.o: Disperse form: single hit %1$s, burst radius %2$s, splash %3$s, smashing the group around the landing point.
Focus form: single hit %1$s, burst radius %2$s — one thin pillar on one target.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar rises to %2$s power and the burst radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.luminacrash.preference: On: burst radius ×1.5 and splash ×1.3, but single hit ×0.85, +2 ticks wind-up and +5 ticks cooldown — for smashing a group. Off (focus): one thin pillar with a heavier single hit.
Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: when other foes stand near the target it favors calling light down, smashing them together; off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
world_combat.move.luminacrash.text.miss: Lumina Crash fell on empty ground
